title: Thursday release rundown and change digest
content:
Attendees: Sofia (notes), Marcus, Priya, Evan, Leah, Tom (brief), QA on call: Jamie

Goal: Quick sync for Thursday change window + intake triage for two incoming hotfixes. Make go/no-go decisions and assign owners for preflight checks.

1) Summary / TL;DR
- Tomorrow's change window (03/13) remains green for low-risk config/infra changes.
- Two hotfix candidates: HF-001 (latency regressions on 8k token paths) and HF-002 (auth header parsing bug affecting Dedicated customers). HF-001 needs more telemetry validation; HF-002 is high priority for customer impact but small diff.
- Canary for runtime v1.14 will continue in eu-west-1; early metrics show 0.7% increase in p50 but lower p99 for batching-heavy workloads. Continue canary for one more day.

2) Hotfix intake notes
- HF-001: "kv-cache-ttl-adjust" (Jira RINF-1487)
  - Symptom: small but consistent p99 latency bump for long-context requests after recent cache invalidation change.
  - Owner: Marcus Chen
  - Current status: PR opened (#3221), unit + integration tests added, perf harness run shows 3–4% improvement in synthetic tests but we need staging traffic validation.
  - Blockers: need longer tail sampling on staging (8k TTFB traces). Request SRE to enable extended sampling for next 12 hours.

- HF-002: "auth-legacy-header-compat" (internal ticket HF-002)
  - Symptom: some Dedicated tenants seeing 400s when migrating from older client. Affects ~4 customers (severity P1 for those accounts).
  - Owner: Priya Nair
  - Plan: apply minimal parser fix + add compatibility toggle behind feature flag in config store. Canary rollout to a single Dedicated pool first.
  - Rollback: revert toggle, no schema changes. Expected deploy time < 15m.

Decision: Proceed to schedule HF-002 for immediate post-window hotfix if HF-001 does not clear extended staging check. If HF-001 validated before window ends, include in Friday midnight minor release.

3) Change window schedule (03/13)
- 02:45 UTC: preflight checks kick off (owners: Leah + Jamie)
- 03:00 UTC: maintenance window opens
- 03:00–03:30 UTC: non-disruptive infra changes (network ACL tuning) — deploy team: infra (Tom)
- 03:30–04:15 UTC: config rollouts and feature toggles (owners: Sofia + Priya)
- 04:15–04:45 UTC: canary validation check-in (metrics owner: Evan)
- 04:45 UTC: finalize go/no-go for remaining hotfix push (rotation lead: Marcus)
- 05:00 UTC: window close / begin post-window monitoring for 2 hours (SLO ops: Leah)

Checklist for preflight (owners noted)
- Latest canary telemetry available? (Evan)
- Backups / DB snapshots complete? (Tom)
- Rollback runbooks attached and smoke scripts validated? (Leah)
- Customer comms queued (for HF-002 targets) (Priya)

4) Canary status details
- Runtime v1.14 in eu-west-1 (canary pool ~6% of traffic)
- Observed: p50 +0.7%, p95 +0.2%, p99 -1.3% for generation workloads with batching enabled. Memory side-effects: transient vm swap events in 2/3 of nodes (low severity) correlated with a kernel upgrade prior to canary launch.
- Action: hold cross-region canary until kernel patch validated - SRE to revert to previous kernel on 1 node and re-run canary subset. (Owner: Evan / Tom)

5) Rollback and mitigation playbook (short)
- If p99 regression > 5% or customer errors spike > 0.5%: immediate rollback to last stable image via orchestration (conductor revert). Owner: Marcus.
- If Dedicated auth errors reappear after HF-002: flip compatibility toggle off and notify affected tenants. Owner: Priya.

6) Incidents / anomalies observed this week (brief)
- Wed 03/11: transient DB connection saturations during heavy embedding batch job — mitigated by temporarily throttling job (postmortem in progress). Owner: Leah (PM).
- Tue 03/10: flaky orchestration backend causing 502s for a 20min window; root cause likely a retry storm from a consumer service - ops rule added to circuit-break consumer service.

7) Action items (concrete, with due dates)
- Marcus: Enable extended staging tail sampling for HF-001 and capture 8k traces by 03/12 22:00 UTC. (IN PROGRESS)
- Priya: Prepare targeted customer comm for HF-002, include rollback contact and expected downtime < 5m, by 03/12 23:30 UTC. (DONE)
- Evan: Run kernel revert experiment on one canary node and report metrics within 3 hours. (OWNER)
- Leah: Validate smoke scripts and attach runbook links to ticket before preflight. Due 03/13 02:30 UTC. (PENDING)
- Tom: Ensure DB snapshot completed and retention verified by 03/13 01:30 UTC. (PENDING)

8) Open questions / parking lot
- Do we want to standardize the feature-flag toggles naming scheme across Dedicated pools? (Priya to propose in repo)
- Can we automate the extended tail sampling toggle into the perf harness? (Evan to spike)
- Need a shorter on-call play for customer-facing rollbacks — too many cross-team handoffs. Suggest a 2-person release ops rotation doc.

9) Quick notes from QA (Jamie)
- Test coverage gap: multi-tenant Dedicated auth regression not covered in current CI suite. Add a smoke e2e for legacy header scenarios. Estimated ~2d to implement.

10) Post-meeting checklist (today)
- Publish brief to slack #release-ops (Sofia) — include HF decision and customer note snippet.
- Tag PRs for HF-002 and HF-001 with "release-ready" label if staging checks pass.
- Schedule 30min follow-up at 04:00 UTC to confirm canary metrics and final decisions. Invite: owners + SRE + QA.

Notes / shorthand: keep this doc as the single source of truth for todays window. If new info comes in, update ticket RINF-1487 or spawn HF-003 if needed.

-- end --
